about: Every file NIDO's signed catalog downloads from a NIDO GitHub release, with the SHA-256 it was published with. A release file is never replaced: an installed app only accepts the exact bytes its own catalog names, so overwriting a file breaks every older app that points to it (it happened once: knowledge-packs-v5/nido-local was republished for 0.1.58 and 0.1.57 could no longer download it). A new version of a pack goes to a NEW release tag (knowledge-packs-v6, v7…) and gets a NEW line here. Never edit an existing line. src/models/packReleaseLedger.test.ts enforces it.

replacedOnce.about: The bytes knowledge-packs-v5 served before it was republished (NIDO 0.1.57 and older expect these). Kept as a record of the mistake; never reuse this pattern.
